TLDR: Async builds AI agents that change how real economy small businesses can run. Law firms, healthcare clinics, real estate companies, and childcare facilities hire our AI agents to automate complex work that's never been economical to staff with humans. Every day, our agents complete work from scheduling clinical therapy appointments, to drafting long legal documents, to entering data into legacy practice management systems. We've automated thousands of hours worth of work for small businesses around the country.<br />
<br />
<strong>The Problem:</strong><br />
Small businesses lack the ability to effectively adopt AI.</p>
<ul>
<li>Effective adoption requires rebuilding operating procedures to be agent first, instead of human first. SMB owners generally lack the time and knowledge to do this.</li>
<li>Out-of-the-box solutions fail to make an outsized impact within complex operations.</li>
<li>These businesses cannot grow without scaling headcount.</li>
</ul>
<p><br />
<strong>The Solution:</strong><br />
We rebuild workflows and deploy AI agents to automate them end-to-end.</p>
<ul>
<li>We build a configurable platform that lets us quickly deploy specialized AI agents inside of their business.</li>
<li>These agents work within our platform and on top of legacy systems.</li>
<li>The work our agents handle for customers spans everything from drafting real-estate closing documents, to coordinating scheduling for ABA therapy appointments, to handling data entry into legacy legal software systems.</li>
</ul>
<p><br />
<strong>Asks:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Introductions to small businesses (especially within law, healthcare, real estate, and childcare) would be greatly appreciated.</li>
